name: air-hockey
description: Fast-paced neon air hockey with a computer opponent and direct peer-to-peer multiplayer over WebRTC.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run check && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --sourcemap --outfile=dist/air-hockey.js && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.js
